verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no in-product AI that surfaces insights or suggestions from the user's data. Trend summaries and forecasts are produced by external assistants (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT) reading Kick data in Google Sheets or through MCP/CLI, which are user-side or external tools rather than Kick's own capability. Kick's native AI is transaction auto-categorization, an adjacent automation feature, not an insights or suggestions surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
